item.title: Modi congratulates Tarique Rahman

item.title: US embassy congratulates Tarique Rahman on 'historic victory'
item.description: The United States Embassy in Dhaka has congratulated the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) and its chairman Tarique Rahman for 'historic victory' in the 13th National Parliamentary Election.The mission made the statement in a post on its official Facebook page at 7:48AM on Friday.It wrote, ''Congratulations to the people of Bangladesh on a successful election and to the Bangladesh Nationalist Party and Tarique Rahman on your historic victory.''''The United States looks forward to working with y

item.title: Pakistan President Zardari congratulates Tarique Rahman
item.description: Pakistan has congratulated Bangladesh Nationalist Party and its Chairman Tarique Rahman for winning the landslide victory in the 13th National Parliamentary Election.In the congratulatory message, President Asif Ali Zardari reaffirmed Pakistan’s support for Bangladesh’s democratic aspirations and expressed Islamabad’s willingness to work with the incoming government to enhance cooperation in trade, defense, and cultural exchange.

item.title: No victory rally, BNP calls for nationwide prayers
item.description: BNP has called for restraint and nationwide prayers rather than public celebrations for winning in the 13th National Parliamentary Election.BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman has directed leaders and activists to offer special prayers across the country after Jum'a prayers on Friday, a notice confirmed this.He has also asked party leaders and supporters not to organise any victory rallies or gatherings anywhere in the country.

item.title: 59.44pc voter turnout nationwide: EC
item.description: The Election Commission (EC) has reported that 59.44 per cent of votes were cast in 299 constituencies across the country.On Friday, EC Director (Public Relations) and Information Officer Md Ruhul Amin Mallik provided this information.Voting in 299 constituencies was held on Thursday (February 12) from 7:30AM to 4:30PM, continuing uninterrupted for nine hours.In this election, the total number of registered voters in the country is 127,711,793. item.title: Results of three constituencies postponed
item.description: Election Commission (EC) has decided to put off the results of three constituencies in the 13th national parliament election.The seats are Sherpur-2, Chattogram-2 and Chattogram-4.The results were postponed due to legal issues of the winning candidates, said senior assistant secretary of the EC Secretariat Md Shahidul Islam.The Commission in separate notifications said it is legally obligated to withhold the publication of results until the final disposal of the relevant cases.Appellate Division

item.title: Abdul Awal Mintoo unofficially elected in Feni-3
item.description: Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) candidate Abdul Awal Mintoo has been unofficially elected from the Feni-3 constituency with 1,57,425 votes.According to the unofficially announced results, his closest rival, Mohammad Fakhruddin of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami received 1, 08,160 votes.In the same constituency, a total of 1, 61,321 'yes' votes were cast, while 1,00,014 voters cast 'no' votes.The information was disclosed during a formal briefing at the Referendum and Thirteenth National Parliament

item.title: Jamaat wins 5 seats in Rangpur, NCP one
